final: WITH currency_avgs AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / NULLIF(feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS mean_rebate FROM currency_avgs) SELECT AVG(c.avg_rebate) AS avg_rebate, AVG(c.avg_relative_gap) AS avg_relative_gap, AVG(c.avg_rebate - b.mean_rebate) AS avg_excess_rebate FROM currency_avgs AS c CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE c.avg_rebate > b.mean_rebate
